newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SIAULIU BANK JAN-APRIL PROFIT 568,000 LITAS.
newsitem.headline: SIAULIU BANK JAN-APRIL PROFIT 568,000 LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's only regional bank, Siauliu Bank, said on Tuesday that its net profit in the first four months of the year was 568,000 litas and its April profit was 208,000 litas.
The bank reported earlier that its net profit fell to 360,000 litas in the first quarter of this year compared to 1.5 million litas in the same period in 1996.
Its profit for 1996 was 3.9 million litas compared to 2.9 million litas in losses the previous year.
The bank's deputy chairman, Dontatas Savickas, also said that the assets of the bank at the end of April were 79.8 million litas compared to 70.7 million litas at the beginning of the year.
He added that the loan porfolio of the bank advanced to 50.9 million litas versus 42.2 million litas at the start of the year.
Deposits in the bank rose to 50.1 million litas at the end of last month compared to 42.3 million litas at the beginning of 1997.

Lithuania's second largest private bank, Hermis Bank, said last month that it wished to acquire a majority stake in Siauliu Bank, but Siauliu said that its shareholders were not interested in selling off their stakes.
Siauliu Bank is the only small regional bank to have emerged relatively unscathed from the rubble of last year's banking crisis.
